purpose: Atomic metric contract for matched civilian UAS, maritime and civil-aviation comparisons. Every result must use a pinned denominator, admissible truth source, strata, comparison rule and explicit NOT_EVALUABLE disposition.
normative_principles: Track A evidence/reconciliation results never substitute for Track B sensor detection results.
Physical sensor inputs are modality-specific; identical physical inputs are not required and must not be fabricated.
A metric without its required denominator, truth authority or eligible exposure is NOT_EVALUABLE, not zero.
No single aggregate score may compensate for a false corroboration, rights, privacy, authority or safety hard-gate failure.
Unknown, stale, unobservable, unavailable, unequipped and withheld exposure is not silently counted as a negative observation.
All results are paired on the same event frame and matched operating conditions where comparison is claimed.

metrics.name: Event-level probability of detection
metrics.definition: Fraction of independently adjudicated eligible positive events for which the evaluated sensor reports a matched observation within the predeclared temporal/spatial tolerance.
metrics.denominator: All eligible independently adjudicated positive events in the declared observation exposure
metrics.truth: Independent ground-truth event set with authority, capture method, time window, tolerance and adjudication recorded
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent positive-event denominator, unqualified observation exposure or matched event tolerance.
metrics.comparison: Same truth set and inclusion rules; sensor modality-specific input; never equate with Track A evidence completeness.

metrics.name: Event precision
metrics.definition: Fraction of evaluated detections that match an independently adjudicated positive event.
metrics.denominator: All detections retained by the frozen deduplication policy, including false and ambiguous detections
metrics.truth: Independent ground-truth event set and predeclared matching/deduplication policy
metrics.not_evaluable: No adjudicated event set or deterministic event-matching rule.
metrics.comparison: Report alongside recall and false alerts per exposure; precision alone is prevalence-sensitive.

metrics.name: False alerts per monitored hour
metrics.definition: Number of false event alerts divided by valid monitored exposure hours.
metrics.numerator: False alerts confirmed by independent adjudication
metrics.denominator: Hours in which the source was authorized, applicable, healthy and observable under the declared scope
metrics.truth: Independent adjudication plus source-health and observability record
metrics.not_evaluable: No qualified source-health and eligible exposure-hours denominator.
metrics.comparison: Do not use wall-clock deployment hours when the feed was unavailable, unobservable, withheld or out of profile.

metrics.name: False alerts per site-day
metrics.definition: False alerts divided by qualified site-days under the declared operating profile.
metrics.denominator: Complete site-days with declared monitor hours, system availability and permitted scope
metrics.truth: Independent event adjudication and complete monitoring logs
metrics.not_evaluable: Incomplete monitor-day logs or non-comparable site-hours.
metrics.comparison: Report with false alerts/hour; a site-day is not a fixed exposure unless its duration is declared.

metrics.name: Track completeness
metrics.definition: Fraction of the independently adjudicated in-scope target-time interval represented by a correctly associated evaluated track.
metrics.denominator: Total eligible target-seconds from independent truth during qualified observable intervals
metrics.truth: Independent truth tracks or event-time intervals; source and association rules pinned
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent truth track or no defined target-time eligibility.
metrics.comparison: Do not treat absence outside the sensor's qualified coverage as a track gap.

metrics.name: Track continuity
metrics.definition: Number of unjustified track breaks per eligible target-hour after applying a frozen gap-tolerance rule.
metrics.numerator: Track breaks not explained by truth/source availability or permitted reacquisition rules
metrics.denominator: Eligible truth target-hours under qualified observation
metrics.truth: Independent truth trajectory or track continuity labels; explicit break/reacquisition policy
metrics.not_evaluable: No ground-truth continuity intervals or gap-tolerance policy.
metrics.comparison: Publish track-ID switch rate separately; do not conflate sensor dropout and association fragmentation.

metrics.name: Track ambiguity
metrics.definition: Fraction of eligible epochs in which the system maintains multiple competing associations for the same truth object or event.
metrics.numerator: Ambiguous epochs under predeclared association rules
metrics.denominator: All eligible truth-linked epochs
metrics.truth: Independent truth plus frozen association adjudication
metrics.not_evaluable: No event association truth or ambiguity definition.
metrics.comparison: Report alongside false association and abstention, not as a substitute.

metrics.name: Spurious track burden
metrics.definition: Time-weighted duration of tracks with no matching independently adjudicated object, divided by qualified monitoring hours.
metrics.numerator: Seconds occupied by independently adjudicated false tracks
metrics.denominator: Qualified monitored hours
metrics.truth: Independent truth and track matching protocol
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent truth, time-synchronized track records or eligible exposure.
metrics.comparison: Keep false tracks distinct from alert counts; one false track can generate repeated alerts.

metrics.name: Position error
metrics.definition: Distribution of horizontal position error for correctly matched observations or tracks against independent truth.
metrics.numerator: Not a ratio; report median, p95, RMSE and sample count of matched errors
metrics.denominator: Matched truth-linked samples only; report coverage and unmatched count separately
metrics.truth: Independent position reference with declared CRS, datum, epoch, uncertainty and synchronization
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent position truth or coordinate-reference compatibility.
metrics.comparison: Do not score unqualified or unmatched events as zero error; keep no-coverage separate.

metrics.name: Velocity error
metrics.definition: Distribution of velocity-vector error for correctly associated samples against independent truth.
metrics.numerator: Not a ratio; report median, p95, RMSE and sample count
metrics.denominator: Matched samples with truth velocity and qualified time synchronization
metrics.truth: Independent truth velocity, CRS/datum and time uncertainty
metrics.not_evaluable: No reliable independent velocity truth or time synchronization.
metrics.comparison: Do not infer velocity accuracy from displayed smoothness or vendor screenshots.

metrics.name: Time to first qualified observation
metrics.definition: Elapsed event-time from independent ground-truth onset to first qualified source observation.
metrics.numerator: Not a ratio; report median, p90, p95 and censoring count
metrics.denominator: Eligible positive truth events with a defined onset and qualified exposure
metrics.truth: Independent event onset and source event-time record
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent onset time, uncertain clock or no eligible event set.
metrics.comparison: Separate sensor event time, receipt time and human-review time.

metrics.name: Class-wise identification precision/recall/F1
metrics.definition: Per-class classification metrics using only predeclared non-intent classes supported by the truth protocol.
metrics.numerator: Per class: TP, FP, FN; publish confusion matrix
metrics.denominator: All adjudicated class instances and system class outputs in eligible observations
metrics.truth: Independent class labels with annotation provenance and adjudicator
metrics.not_evaluable: Class truth is not independently adjudicated, class not in source scope, or intent semantics are used.
metrics.comparison: Keep UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN explicit; no hostile/friendly intent class is accepted.

metrics.name: Identification false-alarm fraction
metrics.definition: Fraction of emitted identification decisions that are false under the frozen label set.
metrics.denominator: All emitted identification decisions; also publish decisions abstained and unclassified
metrics.truth: Independent class truth for the declared label ontology
metrics.not_evaluable: No admissible class-truth set or label ontology not pinned.
metrics.comparison: Do not interchange this with false alerts per hour.

metrics.name: Coverage-qualified non-observation promotion error
metrics.definition: Fraction of cases with unknown, incomplete, stale, unavailable, not-equipped or unobservable coverage that are incorrectly reported as NOT_OBSERVED_WITHIN_DECLARED_COVERAGE.
metrics.denominator: All oracle cases that require a non-negative unknown/unavailable/unobservable state
metrics.truth: Frozen synthetic coverage oracle or independently stewarded source-health/coverage records
metrics.not_evaluable: No explicit source coverage, health and applicability oracle.
metrics.comparison: Hard gate: zero in deterministic negative controls.

metrics.name: Negative-claim overreach
metrics.definition: Fraction of source-scoped non-observation outputs expanded into physical absence, complete census, universal scope, intent or non-compliance claims.
metrics.denominator: All source-scoped NOT_OBSERVED_WITHIN_DECLARED_COVERAGE outputs
metrics.truth: Claim-scope oracle
metrics.not_evaluable: No traceable output claim scope.
metrics.comparison: Hard gate: zero overclaims.

metrics.name: Coverage-gap interval recall
metrics.definition: Fraction of oracle-known uncovered interval duration that the system explicitly preserves as a gap or unavailable state.
metrics.denominator: Total oracle-known uncovered interval duration
metrics.truth: Independent coverage interval oracle
metrics.not_evaluable: No time-qualified coverage and source-health intervals.
metrics.comparison: A gap must block full-window negative claims regardless of detection list.

metrics.name: False independent corroboration
metrics.definition: Fraction of oracle-dependent source sets the system describes as independently corroborated.
metrics.numerator: Dependent source sets promoted to independent support
metrics.denominator: All oracle-dependent source sets in the frozen fixture/confirmatory corpus
metrics.truth: Time-qualified dependency hypergraph oracle and exact evidence frontier
metrics.not_evaluable: No source dependency inventory or independent oracle.
metrics.comparison: Hard gate: zero on deterministic negative controls.

metrics.name: Dependency edge recall/precision
metrics.definition: Precision and recall for declared transitive common-dependency edges, computed separately by dependency dimension.
metrics.numerator: Correctly recovered dependency edges / recovered incorrect edges
metrics.denominator: Oracle dependency edges / predicted edges
metrics.truth: Frozen stewarded graph with source-derived edge evidence
metrics.not_evaluable: No independently stewarded dependency graph.
metrics.comparison: No single scalar trust score; dimension-specific results required.

metrics.name: Unknown-dependency abstention correctness
metrics.definition: Fraction of cases with missing, stale, conflicted or outside-frontier dependency evidence that remain UNKNOWN or abstain.
metrics.denominator: All oracle cases requiring unknown dependency treatment
metrics.truth: Frozen dependency-frontier and completeness oracle
metrics.not_evaluable: No explicit inventory completeness/frontier state.
metrics.comparison: Unknown is not independent; zero promotion in negative controls.

metrics.name: Provenance reference completeness
metrics.definition: Fraction of required source, revision, capture, time, rights, transformation and evaluator references present and resolvable in an event envelope.
metrics.denominator: All required references defined by the pinned domain profile
metrics.truth: Profile/schema oracle plus artifact digest verification
metrics.not_evaluable: No pinned required-reference profile.
metrics.comparison: Presence of a URI alone is not authentication or source truth.

metrics.name: Correction propagation latency
metrics.definition: Elapsed time from receipt of a qualified correction to all derived reports being marked corrected/superseded or blocked.
metrics.numerator: Not ratio; median/p95 and stale-derived count
metrics.denominator: All initiated correction events
metrics.truth: Exact correction event and derived artifact lineage
metrics.not_evaluable: No pinned correction lineage or timestamp ordering.
metrics.comparison: Prior historical views must remain reproducible at their original evidence frontier.

metrics.name: Replay reproducibility
metrics.definition: Fraction of exact-input replays that reproduce the same canonical report bytes or semantically pinned report digest under the same evaluator build.
metrics.denominator: All initiated identical-input replay runs
metrics.truth: Frozen input, evaluator, schema, policy and environment digests
metrics.not_evaluable: Missing exact digests or incomplete run census.
metrics.comparison: Failed, aborted and abstained runs remain in the run census.

metrics.name: Risk-coverage curve and AURC
metrics.definition: Selective error risk as coverage increases by lowering abstention; report full curve, AURC and selected operating points.
metrics.numerator: Incorrect/unsafe accepted claims at each coverage point
metrics.denominator: All accepted claims at that coverage point
metrics.truth: Independent adjudication for the task being scored
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent labels or well-defined acceptance/abstention policy.
metrics.comparison: Compare at matched coverage; do not present AURC alone without coverage curve.

metrics.name: Human review time
metrics.definition: Active human time to locate, inspect and adjudicate the required evidence packet.
metrics.denominator: All assigned review cases, including unresolved/abstained cases; report separately by disposition
metrics.truth: Time-stamped workflow logs and blinded reviewer study
metrics.not_evaluable: No consistent start/stop rules or missing reviewer telemetry.
metrics.comparison: Same reviewers or balanced randomized assignments; same information and permitted review budget.

metrics.name: False-review burden
metrics.definition: Number of human reviews later adjudicated as unsupported, duplicate or non-actionable per 100 eligible cases.
metrics.denominator: Eligible cases under frozen event and deduplication policy, scaled to 100
metrics.truth: Blinded adjudication panel and duplicate-resolution policy
metrics.not_evaluable: No independent final adjudication or duplicate policy.
metrics.comparison: Measure alongside missed events and required unresolved reviews.

metrics.name: Handoff completeness
metrics.definition: Fraction of required evidence, uncertainty, source limitation, unresolved issue and authority boundary fields present in a receiving operator's handoff.
metrics.denominator: All profile-required handoff fields
metrics.truth: Pre-registered task checklist and independent reviewer
metrics.not_evaluable: No role-specific handoff profile or blinded scoring.
metrics.comparison: Score completeness separately from reviewer speed.

metrics.name: Lifecycle cost per qualified monitoring hour
metrics.definition: Fully loaded lifecycle cost divided by qualified monitoring hours, with data rights, staffing, maintenance, calibration, network, storage, integration, downtime and decommissioning included.
metrics.numerator: Annualized/period lifecycle cost in declared base-year currency
metrics.denominator: Qualified monitoring hours within authorized scope
metrics.truth: Audited invoices, time allocation, maintenance and uptime logs
metrics.not_evaluable: Incomplete costs, uncertain uptime or unqualified exposure.
metrics.comparison: Currency/base year and allocation rules must match; do not price free/unlicensed data as zero.

non_compensatory_hard_gates: false independent corroboration on deterministic negative controls == 0
false-negative-evidence promotion on deterministic negative controls == 0
active mitigation, third-party control and operator geolocation in benchmark == 0

aggregation_policy.reason: A composite can mask incomparable denominators, modality differences and hard-gate failures. Any future aggregate must be separately preregistered with public weights and can never compensate for a nonzero hard gate.

claim_ceiling: This catalogue defines how future matched metrics must be measured. It contains no vendor score, no SOTA result and no field-performance claim.
